entries.title: Fixed Inclined Rails and Level Caisson Carriage
entries.description: One complete newly authored fixed inclined-caisson boat-lift-style exterior. A full horizontal thick U-section vessel has a dry blind floor, thin high side walls and two entire closed end gates in separate open-head guide portals. Beneath it, two complete open wedge carriage frames connect the level vessel bearers to two transverse axles and four rail wheels at different heights on a single continuous inclined twin track. The rails have their own grounded supports and ties. A separate high-end anchored haul station carries a complete flanged drum, cross-shaft and two full fixed strands into the carriage end. The long level gated chamber over unequal-height open carriage frames, long rising guide infrastructure and end haul station are authored together; no old boat, dock, ramp, hopper or carriage mesh is reused. Unlike the floating dock the chamber is lifted on rail wheels rather than resting on broad hull wings, and unlike the mixing skip there is no hopper mouth feeding a stationary processing pan. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up and full horizontal bounds centred, one prop zero scenes. Static dry artistic exterior only, no ship, water or host canals. No actual travel, gate opening, level control, cable reeving or winding, wheel contact tolerances, watertightness, lift capacity, buoyancy, docking, rail compatibility, structural load, manufacture, operation or engineering safety. Rigging animation and interaction not made or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Open Ended U Channel and Short Grip Tray
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty U-channel impression-tray-style visual prop. A continuous curved shallow trough follows both straight rear tails and the rounded front, with complete finite inner and outer walls, a genuine central open-backed void and bounded openings through the narrow curved floor. Both rear trough ends remain open above their floor rather than closing a rectangular box. One complete short flat anterior handle enters the front wall and carries a blank opaque grip inset. All geometry newly authored as a connected conforming curved cell boundary, not a rectangular parts tray bent, an extracted dental-unit accessory, or the upright perforated masher with its grip shortened. The whole horizontal open U-channel and its double-sided raised rim differ from a closed rectangular sorting basin and from a flat perforated pressing plate with an upright U frame. Three opaque untextured materials, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred and lower trough datum grounded. One model zero scenes. Static empty artistic exterior only: no teeth, mouth, patient, impression material, anatomical accuracy, bodily fit, clinical use, diagnosis, hygiene, sterilization, capacity, fabrication or safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Three Brush and Rail Carriage Wash Portal
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete empty vehicle-wash-portal-style static exterior. Two full ground rails support four fixed wheels and two long carriage feet beneath a high open through-portal. Two independently supported front swing-arm appearances suspend whole vertical fluted brush cylinders with complete upper shafts and lower hubs. A separate broad horizontal fluted cylinder sits on its full axle between two vertical guide-carriage appearances inside the portal, with genuine bored sleeves, full guides and a raised crosshead. A whole side service case and blank control face belong to the same machine. This is not the low shoe-polisher enlarged: that old backed foot bay contains only paired coaxial horizontal rolls, while the new full-height through-lane has opposed vertical brushes and an independent upper cross-brush on a travelling portal exterior. It is not the old three-axis gantry fitted with renamed fingers: no fixed four-post overhead rail cage or central downward tool survives. All coordinates newly authored, no old mesh imported. Four opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up and whole centred ground datum, one model zero scenes. Empty dry fixed visual only: no vehicle, bristles at fibre scale, water, fluid circuit, cleaning, brush contact, rail travel, brush rotation, drive transmission, vehicle clearance, electrical operation, machinery guarding, manufacture, installation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Footed Stator and Cage Rotor Motor Cutaway
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete horizontal electric-motor-style cutaway display. Four whole integral-shoulder feet carry a constant-diameter thick case with a deliberate upper-near longitudinal cut. A separate thick annular stator-like body and two complete copper-coloured end-winding-loop appearances surround a genuine interior rotor interval. One long bored rotor-core exterior carries one continuous ring-and-skew-bar cage whose two complete annular ends and twelve axial bars share actual material roots; spaces between those bars remain real geometry. One full through shaft projects from two separate complete stepped, genuinely bored end shields. A closed side terminal-box exterior with a proud blank lid belongs to the case. This whole coaxial stator/core/cage/end-shield organisation is not the older U-shaped magnet with exposed winding rotor, split rings and hand crank, and it is not a front fan with a small solid core inside a long tapered bypass cowl. All visible geometry newly authored, no old generator, engine, fan or rotor meshes imported or extracted. One complete prop zero scenes, four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres native Z up and full horizontal-envelope-centred foot datum. This is an invented static illustrative appearance with simplified end windings and deliberately fixed support overlaps, not an accurate motor section, winding diagram or manufactured assembly. No electric circuit, wiring, insulation, magnetic field, voltage, current, induction, rotation, torque, cooling, heat, efficiency, bearing fit, electrical compatibility, manufacture, installation, operation or equipment safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made or verified.
